scraped.scraped_description: CKAN is an open-source DMS (data management system) for powering data hubs and data portals. CKAN makes it easy to publish, share and use data.

name: CKAN
tagline: The world's leading open source data management system for powering data hubs and data portals
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Moderate - depends on Open Knowledge Foundation for governance and core maintenance; community contributions essential for sustainability

news_articles.title: CKAN: The Open Data Platform Powering Governments Worldwide
How Open Data Platforms Are Transforming Government Transparency

academic_citations.title: Open Data Platforms and Government Transparency: A Systematic Review

policy_outcomes.description: Used by national and regional government organisations throughout the European Union, the Americas, Asia and Oceania to power official and community data portals
Government of Canada uses CKAN to make tens of thousands of datasets accessible
Singapore Government uses CKAN as open data portal for economic, education, environment, finance, and health data
Australian Government uses CKAN to make available public data from over 800 different organisations

outcome_methodology: Observational - tracking government adoption and data portal implementations; no randomized controlled trials
published_performance_metrics: CKAN instances track dataset counts, user engagement, and API usage; metrics vary by deployment
documented_limitations: Requires technical expertise for deployment and customization
Data quality depends on publisher compliance
failure_modes: Data portal abandonment if not maintained by government
Low adoption rates in regions with limited technical capacity
Data quality issues when publishers lack resources
curation_criteria: Open source contribution guidelines; community-driven feature development; Open Knowledge Foundation oversight
contributor_governance: Community-based with Open Knowledge Foundation stewardship; GitHub-based contribution process; regular community calls
disparity_tracking: Not formally tracked; CKAN aims to increase data access equity across regions and organizations
community_ownership: Shared - Open Knowledge Foundation provides governance; global community of developers and government users
ai_involvement: Minimal - CKAN is a data management platform; some instances may use AI for data discovery or classification, but not core functionality
political_relevance_summary: Tackles opacity in government operations by enabling public access to government data and processes.

movement_building_utility.notes: Provides foundational technical infrastructure for civic technology.

generalizability_notes: Open-source codebase facilitates replication and adaptation. Already deployed across multiple jurisdictions (7 countries), demonstrating cross-context adaptability.
primary_users_or_beneficiaries: members of the public seeking government information
